expected.identifiers: Run IDs, publication IDs, evidence IDs and message IDs are allocated per replay (random run_id; tenant/Site/gateway UUIDs per import), so none is pinned; counts are.
expected.why_not_verified: The shipped mini-grid generator policy (simulator/assetops_simulator/packs/mini_grid.py decide()) starts the generator at state of charge <= start-soc-threshold (35 %) and stops it at >= stop-soc-threshold (90 %); it never reads the battery reserve. The reserve only floors battery discharge. Lowering it 30 -> 25 lets the battery discharge five points further while the generator cannot cover the mill, so the later run enters the Candidate period five SOC points lower (67.75 vs 72.75 at 08:00, 82 vs 87 at 09:00) and the generator runs 20 minutes longer (03:45-09:35 vs 03:45-09:15). Every hour with positive baseline Candidate seconds (05:05-09:15) therefore has later Candidate seconds >= baseline (target miss) and a 5-point initial-SOC gap (outside the 2-point band), so with this model VERIFIED is unreachable and the settled verdict is INCONCLUSIVE. The seed only draws publication dropout, so no seed changes this.
